title: AITEX — Association of Information Technology Experts
note: Associate Member. Admitted after review by Expert Review Committee of distinguished technology leaders.

title: Hackathon Raptors — Fellow
note: Fellowship requiring peer-review by 5+ existing fellows. Members include engineers from Meta, Amazon, NVIDIA, Salesforce.

title: IAHD — International Association of Honored Developers
note: Multi-level application: case review, mentor interviews, expert council vote. Members include engineers from Google, UniCredit Bank, Natera.

title: International Association of IT Professionals
note: Selection by Expert Council of internationally recognized IT specialists.

title: RAEC — Russian Association of Electronic Communications
note: Artificial Intelligence cluster. Members include Mail.ru Group, Google, Rambler. Selection by RAEC Council.

title: International Association of Entrepreneurs and Executives
note: Selection by expert committee of outstanding entrepreneurs. Members include directors from Tinkoff Group, ASER.
